subtype: Raising arms to be picked up [Expressing]
passage: At the gate of the market, Rajni was juggling two bags and her phone. Vishal, two, tugged at her kurta, then stretched both arms straight up and looked into her eyes. “Up.” She checked the bags and crouched. “Okay, come.” She lifted him onto her hip and he put his head on her shoulder, warm and quiet. His legs dangled and he sighed once. Rajni kept the bags on her other arm and walked on.

qa.q: What was Rajni carrying when Vishal raised his arms?
What might Vishal's raised arms and look mean he wanted?
qa.a: They show he wanted to be lifted and close to her. It could also be tiredness from walking, or wanting a better view.

qa.q: What could Rajni do if her hands were too full?
qa.a: She could kneel, hug him for a moment and tell him she will lift him as soon as she puts the bags down.

qa.q: How might Vishal feel when she lifts him?
qa.a: He may feel safe and looked after because his request was answered.

grounding: A toddler raises both arms to be picked up, a clear request for closeness that the adult answers.

subtype: Raising arms to be picked up [Expressing]
passage:
“Chaitanya, we're at the top of the stairs,” said Lalit. “Good walking.”
Chaitanya looked up at him and lifted both arms.
“Up?”
“You want me to carry you?”
“Up, Papa.”
“All right, all right.” He lifted her and she wound her arms round his neck.
“Tired?” he asked.
She nodded against his shoulder.
“Then we'll rest a bit,” said Lalit, and sat down on the step with her.

qa.q: Where were Lalit and Chaitanya when she raised her arms?
qa.a: At the top of the stairs.

qa.q: What does Chaitanya's raised arms and nod show she wanted?
qa.a: They show she wanted to be carried and was tired. She might also simply have wanted closeness with Papa.

qa.q: What could Lalit do on other tiring days?
qa.a: He could plan rest breaks or let her walk part of the way and carry her the rest.

qa.q: What might Chaitanya feel when he sits down with her?
qa.a: She may feel cared for because Papa noticed her tiredness and stopped for her.

grounding: A toddler raises both arms to be lifted and shows tiredness and a wish for closeness.
